FN-1A8M3L-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 457
Committee: Constitutions, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Elections
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/22/2023
House Bill 457 as introduced would increase the election expenses of the judges of probate by
an undetermined amount, funded half from the State General Fund, for costs related to the
manual post-election audits required by this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the
audit results to the Secretary's website, report the findings to the Governor and Legislature, and
adopt administrative rules to implement this bill.

FN-1A8M3L-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 457
Committee: Constitutions, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Elections
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/24/2023
House Bill 457 as reported by the Committee on Constitutions, Campaigns and Elections would
increase the election expenses of the judges of probate by an undetermined amount, funded from
federal or state funds made available for use by the Secretary of State, for costs related to the
manual post-election audits required by this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the
audit results to the Secretary's website, report the findings to the Governor and Legislature, and
adopt administrative rules to implement this bill.
